alignments.note: Anarthrous substantival passive participle: supplied antecedent and relative *He that* and the copula *is* join its unit (rules 46, 20); head on the lexeme word.
Nomen rectum of the construct; the ASV recasts the relation as *in* and supplies *the* (rules 19, 29).
Second coordinated passive participle; the supplied *hath* is the auxiliary of its rendering, discontinuous around the object phrase under rule 25.
Supplied possessive with no suffix or other possessive morpheme present (rule 18, closing sentence).
Rule 31 subtraction ties; the ASV never writes *member* alone for this noun, so *member* is the supplied generic and the head stays on *privy*. Heading on *member* was the competing reading.
Verb with its auxiliary, discontinuous around the negative (rules 17, 25).
The ASV spends a word on each of preposition and construct noun, so rule 30's one-rendering condition is unmet and rule 2 splits them.

review_notes: The two coordinated passive participles are read as substantives (rule 46); only the supplied possessive *his* is left `added`.
